correctness.rationale: In the actual frozen RESULT.md the degree of a fixed label is a sum of independent Bernoulli trials with mean c_gamma(log(v)/log(n))*log(n)+O(1). Exponential-tail upper bounds and the lower large-deviation bound n^{-I(t;c)+o(1)} reduce the maximum to max_a[a-I(t;c_gamma(a))]. Differentiating yields the interior maximizer 1-t/2 or boundary gamma and the unique cutoff gamma*=1-1/(2log2). Negative quadrant dependence of distinct child-degree events controls the second moment. Polynomial error bounds on dyadic n plus monotonicity prove a.s. coefficient; the unique maximizer of the rate function localizes the label in probability. Assumptions include fixed 0<gamma<1 and independent uniform parent choices.
